scope: Read-only source review of real Android17 raw-key upgrade/rollback paths; no key material/device operation
observed_source: CommitUpgradedKey replaces the original blob, fsyncs, then asks Keystore to delete the old key.
beginOperation commits an upgraded blob immediately unless cp_needsCheckpoint() defers it.
Keystore begin obtains optional upgradedBlob through the real createOperation result.
The ignored-upgradedBlob exception is explicitly for TAG_STORAGE_KEY conversion, not this raw v1 fallback.
Keymaster4 HAL specifies version/patch-level binding and rejects downgrades except the special OS_VERSION0 case; this is not permission to fake a version.
The carried installer still validates Android14 and can apply a recovery-header rewrite; no Android17 installer path is approved.
inference_requiring_hardware_validation: Do not assume an old blob, installed TWRP or a successful source build guarantees rollback after a hardware key upgrade. Actual Samsung TEE behavior and checkpoint state have not been measured.
